_notes.filter_interaction: All filters are radio inputs (type=radio). Storage and carrier filters have the class 'do_ajax' and trigger an AJAX reload when clicked — click the <label> element or the <input> inside it. Condition inputs also have class 'do_ajax'. After clicking a filter, wait for the price rows to update (re-wait on page_load_wait_selector or watch for DOM change). Carrier/network labels use logo images with no visible text — use the input's data-attribute for the display name and the input's value (numeric ID) for the form value.
_notes.vendor_name_notes: Use img.alt from td.logo picture img for the proper display name (e.g. 'BuyBackBoss'). Alternatively, td.logo a[title] gives the lowercase slug (e.g. 'buybackboss'). The picture element has two elements before the — querySelectorAll returns the img specifically.
_notes.duplicate_filter_sets: The page has two sets of capacity labels (6 total, 3 unique) — one for mobile (offsetParent=null, hidden) and one for desktop. Scope to .tell-us-about to get exactly 3 unique capacity labels and avoid mobile duplicates.
_notes.price_row_structure: Each .recycler-price div wraps a single <table> with one visible <tbody> <tr> containing three <td>s: td.logo (vendor info), td.price (shipping/payment details), td.sell (price + CTA button). There are also 15 hidden rows (display:none) in the tbody for expandable detail sections.
